scope: Full local and isolated Linux suites on the candidate private image delivery implementation. Native delivery and product timing remain separate gates.
coverage: Private repository required before upload and resolution
Upload bytes, GitHub asset digest, persisted image identity and pagination
No stored signed URL or server token in artifact metadata
Launch capability, image membership, expiry, legacy clients and concurrent revocation
CDN request has no authorization header and redirects are rejected
Network error, expiry, truncation, oversize and corruption fall back to authorized local delivery
No Docker load when both candidate sources fail integrity
Local publication survives private image storage failure
